theorem lg_target {y z : ℝ} (f : ℝ → ENNReal) (hzy : z ≤ y) : ∫⁻ (x : ℝ) in Set.Iic y, f x = (∫⁻ (x : ℝ) in Set.Iio z, f x) + ∫⁻ (x : ℝ) in Set.Icc z y, f x := by
  have h1 : Set.Iic y = Set.Iio z ∪ Set.Icc z y := by exact Set.Iic_eq_Iio_union_Icc z y hzy
  rw [measure_theory.integral_Union_disjoint]
  refine (measure_theory.integral_split f z y hzy).symm
  exact disjoint_Iio_Icc z y hzy
